meta.document: Phase 7 routing map: 37 v2.0.0 sprint issues to claude-global-library agents and skills
meta.verification: Every primary_agent and supporting_agents[].name was checked for membership in agents_all.json['agents'][*].name AND for an existing agents/<name>/agent.md file. Every skills[] entry was checked for membership in skills_all.json['skills'][*].name AND for an existing skills/<name>/SKILL.md file. Generation aborts on any miss.

dispatch_contract.rule: Library agents are NOT registered subagent_types. Spawn subagent_type 'general-purpose' and inject the agent's persona as a ---persona--- block at the top of the prompt.
dispatch_contract.enforcement: A live PreToolUse hook BLOCKS any generic subagent spawned without a persona block.

routes.title: PRD FR-6 / SRS FR-16: create docs/architecture/ADR-006-hook-free-execution.md
routes.justification: ADR authoring is solution-architect's named output artifact; the job is to place an already-decided ADR at its required path with its Consequence section unedited.

routes.title: PRD FR-9 / SRS FR-20: reconcile claude-global-library master graph count drift
routes.justification: Narrow fix: re-run build_master.py --full, validate.py and test_invariant_checker.py in a second repo and make three count sources agree. That is Python build-script operation (automation-engineer); codebase-kg-engineer supports on graph-artifact invariants.

routes.title: PRD NFR-1 / SRS NFR-7: build the per-component process-count measurement harness
routes.justification: Build an observability/measurement harness over an agentic tool harness, with a pass/fail regression gate. performance-testing-engineer supports on measurement rigour: cold vs warm reported separately, window must not cross a response-turn boundary.

routes.title: PRD FR-1 / SRS FR-10: produce docs/reports/policy-implementation-audit-v2.md
routes.justification: Agent added 2026-08-02, confidence unchanged at HIGH. The 46-row traceability matrix was always business-analyst-agent's; GAP-3 recorded that the surrounding prose of policy-implementation-audit-v2.md had no owner. technical-writer-agent now owns it -- technical-writing-core section 1's Diataxis classification and section 2's task-based information architecture are the missing piece for the report body. Added only to this row of the audit series: V2-005, V2-006 and V2-007 are matrix-cell population with no prose deliverable, and V2-008 is a script.

routes.title: PRD FR-2 / SRS FR-11: populate all 7 audit-matrix columns for all 46 policies
routes.justification: Populate the 7th column across 46 rows from a fixed closed vocabulary. Pure traceability-matrix completion, no second capability needed.

routes.title: PRD FR-3 / SRS FR-12: record a disposition and rationale for each of the 15 hook-coupled policies
routes.justification: A disposition-plus-rationale ledger over 15 hook-coupled policies. solution-architect supports because port-to-MCP / demote-to-advisory / delete are architecture decisions, and push_gate.py's row is pre-decided as port-to-MCP.

routes.title: PRD FR-20 / SRS FR-32: record a post-plugin disposition for all 14 genuine policy orphans
routes.justification: Disposition for 14 orphan policies plus a name-reconciliation script; BA owns the disposition semantics, automation-engineer owns the comparison script.

routes.title: PRD NFR-4 / SRS NFR-10: cross-check all 27 capability_loss.md names against the audit matrix
routes.justification: The deliverable is a script that fails on an empty disposition and on the literal value 'disappeared'. Script authoring is automation-engineer; BA supports on what a valid disposition is. No agent in the library owns coverage-ledger cross-checking as a named capability.

routes.title: PRD FR-9a / SRS FR-21: fix call-graph DISCOVERY truncation
routes.justification: The parser half (discovery caps at call_graph_builder_legacy.py:64 and graph_model.py:43) is ast-graph-engineer's core domain. The strengthened AC is test engineering as much as parser work, so it needs BOTH supporting agents: harness-evaluation-engineer for the probe harness and module-scoped log capture, unit-testing-specialist for the independent enumeration oracle and the negative test that proves the check can fail. SIZE FLAG: the 5-point estimate does not hold with the runtime-proof AC.

routes.title: PRD FR-9b / SRS FR-38: fix the call-graph RESOLVER ambiguous bare-name bind
routes.justification: graph_model.py:265 returning candidates[0] for an ambiguous bare name is exactly call-graph edge-resolution precision (the CHA -> RTA refinement axis). impact-analysis-agent supports because the four fan-in consumers being corrected are danger_zones / hot_nodes blast-radius consumers.

routes.title: PRD FR-10 / SRS FR-22: KG-driven agent and skill selection, zero hardcoded lists
routes.justification: A selector that ranks agents from a knowledge graph with zero hardcoded name literals is agent-routing-dispatch-policy work. codebase-kg-engineer supports on typed-graph edge-path traversal and on verifying edge paths against ast_call_graph.json or a rebuilt FR-9a-fixed graph; python-backend-engineer supplies the implementation in this Python codebase.

routes.title: PRD FR-11 / SRS FR-23: emit selection explainability, five fields per selected agent
routes.justification: Five auditable fields emitted per selected agent during a full LangGraph pipeline run is graph-runtime observability. harness-engineering-architect supports on what a selection record must contain. Confidence is MEDIUM because no agent owns decision-provenance schema design as a named capability.

routes.title: PRD FR-12 / SRS FR-24: explicit no-match and low-confidence fallback path
routes.justification: Defining the no-match / below-threshold outcome so a silent default pick is impossible is dispatch-policy design; the threshold and the explicit stop outcome are both in this agent's mandatory skill set.

routes.title: PRD FR-13 / SRS FR-25: conform to the model fallback protocol
routes.justification: haiku -> sonnet -> opus -> escalate is a cascade router topology with confidence gates, which is this agent's stated design surface. harness-engineering-architect supports on the rate-limit retry/escalation mechanics.

routes.title: PRD FR-14 / SRS FR-26: build the installable plugin manifest, zero hooks, zero .mcp.json
routes.justification: GAP-1 CLOSED 2026-08-02. claude-code-plugin-packaging-core section 1 supplies the .claude-plugin/plugin.json location, the closed eight-field schema (name / version / description / author) and the fixed-name root-level discovery scan, which is the manifest contract the AC requires; section 3 and M3 supply the hook-merge monoid and the proof that per-hook disable is structurally impossible, which is exactly the fact that forced ADR-010's zero-bundled-hooks rule. The agent encodes both as Operating Rules 1, 2 and 5. architecture-conformance-auditor is retained unchanged for the CI gate half the AC names by capability. Residual prompt input: the CONFIRMED-list from orchestration_prompt.md section 1.4 and the measured 2-spawn figure are project artefacts, not domain facts. The eager-spawn rationale for zero .mcp.json lives in mcp-server-engineering-core section 3 / M6, not in the plugin skill.

routes.title: SRS FR-37 / ADR-019: build register-mcp and unregister-mcp
routes.justification: GAP-2 PARTIALLY CLOSED 2026-08-02. mcp-server-engineering-core section 3 supplies the user-scope registration surface by name (the mcpServers block inside ~/.claude/settings.json) and states that registration is a pure configuration mutation that spawns nothing, with unregistration as its exact mirror -- the round trip the AC requires. Section 4 supplies merge-against-fresh-read by that name, correctly labels it a probabilistic narrowing rather than a correctness guarantee, and warns that atomic rename-into-place is NOT a substitute for lost-update protection; the agent encodes both as Operating Rules 7 and 8 and Core Responsibility 6. Held at MEDIUM, not raised to HIGH, for two named reasons: (1) the skill has zero coverage of mcp-base, AtomicJsonStore or the vendored-by-copy propagation hazard (grep-verified: zero hits across all seven delivered files), so the agent will author a 22nd write-safety helper instead of reusing mcp_base/persistence.py:26 unless told; (2) the ADR-020 Path C verification sub-task is a one-shot measurement with no library owner at all. Supply both as prompt notes.

routes.title: SRS NFR-12 / ADR-020: PREVENT and DETECT layers on the push gate
routes.justification: GAP-2 CLOSED for this row 2026-08-02. Layer 1 (unregister-mcp refuses by default and names the consequence) is the unregistration write path, which is mcp-server-engineer Core Responsibility 6 verbatim. Layer 2's 'cheap startup precondition without spawning a process' is directly supported by mcp-server-engineering-core section 3's statement that registration state is pure configuration and that nothing spawns until a session actually needs the server -- so the precondition is a config read, not a probe. site-reliability-engineer is retained for the detective-control and one-unmissable-line signal design. automation-engineer was dropped as primary because the registration-CLI write path it was standing in for is now owned by name.

routes.title: PRD FR-15 / SRS FR-28: AST-classify every home-directory occurrence, then remediate the CODE ones
routes.justification: An AST rule engine that partitions occurrences by enclosing node type (ast.arguments.defaults, ast.Call keyword, assignment RHS, docstring position, tokenize.COMMENT) is exactly static-code-analysis-engine-core, and the exemption of src/utils/path_resolver.py is suppression/exemption governance. python-backend-engineer supports on the remediation edits. Task 2 cannot be sized until task 1 runs.

routes.title: PRD FR-17 / SRS FR-30: pass encoding= at every text-mode open()
routes.justification: A detection rule that must catch the mode-less open(path) form and carry a binary/tarfile/urllib exemption list, applied over 19 sites, is a linter rule with a suppression budget. No second capability needed.

routes.title: PRD FR-16 / SRS FR-29: build-time library snapshot script
routes.justification: Agent added 2026-08-02, confidence deliberately UNCHANGED. claude-code-plugin-packaging-core section 4 / M6 supplies the one thing this row was missing: the snapshot is bundled inside the plugin and must be located through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, never a CWD-relative path -- M6's correct-by-construction vs correct-by-coincidence proof is exactly the failure mode where a snapshot read passes every author-local test and breaks for every installed user. This is NOT a confidence lift, because the stated reason this row was MEDIUM was the three-way capability split (release pipeline / snapshot script / ADV-006 secrets scan), which is unchanged and is now four-way. If the dispatcher caps supporting agents at two, drop devsecops-engineer first -- ADV-006 is a single secrets_check.py invocation.

routes.title: PRD FR-24 / SRS FR-36: publish the uninstall-residue runbook
routes.justification: GAP-3 CLOSED 2026-08-02. The precise reason this row was LOW -- that the library's only runbook skill fires from incident telemetry after a production incident, the wrong trigger for a product uninstall procedure -- is answered head-on by technical-writer-agent's own 'Distinct from postmortem-facilitator-agent' section: 'use this agent when the starting point is a known process that needs to be written down correctly; hand off to postmortem-facilitator-agent when the starting point is a corpus of past incidents that needs to be mined into a decision tree.' V2-021 is the former. procedural-documentation-core section 1 supplies the six-part runbook anatomy (purpose / preconditions / numbered atomic steps / verification points / rollback / escalation) and section 3 grounds each verification point as a literal Hoare postcondition check, which is what 'manual removal steps for each measured path' requires. claude-code-plugin-engineer supports because the residue list is a plugin-lifecycle fact set: packaging-core section 2 covers the orphaned-version cache under ~/.claude/plugins/ and its 7-day retention, and M4 proves why enabledPlugins / extraKnownMarketplaces residue is not cleanly attributable.

routes.title: PRD FR-18 / SRS FR-31: zero plugin-attributable functional residue after uninstall
routes.justification: GAP-1 CLOSED for this row 2026-08-02. The AC's load-bearing word is 'attributable', and claude-code-plugin-packaging-core M4 is a formal derivation of exactly why a four-scope merged settings.json makes uninstall a non-total subtraction, with section 2 stating that bundled resources are install-time side effects into SHARED systems whose contributions co-mingle with other plugins' and the user's own config. That is the reasoning that narrowed FR-18 from whole-file equality to an attributable delta. The agent carries it as Core Responsibility 8, Operating Rule 6 and MUST NOT 3. integration-testing-engineer is retained for part (b), the delta assertion itself.

routes.title: PRD NFR-5 / SRS NFR-11: install, invoke, uninstall and register round-trip lifecycle tests
routes.justification: Gherkin scenarios for install/invoke/uninstall are already written in prd-v2.md section 7, and this agent implements Behave step definitions from Gherkin specs. integration-testing-engineer supports on the register/unregister round trip that crosses a process boundary.

routes.title: PRD FR-23 / SRS FR-35: port push_gate.py to a named MCP tool BEFORE PreToolUse is deleted
routes.justification: GAP-2 CLOSED for this row 2026-08-02. 'Reachable as an MCP tool callable by name' is now a named capability: mcp-server-engineering-core section 1 gives the tools/list -> tools/call primitive triad and the capability declaration that makes a tool reachable, and section 2 gives the descriptor shape (name, description, inputSchema, optional outputSchema), the verb-object naming convention, and the rule that a description must state both mechanism and usage boundary. The agent's Core Responsibility 1 and 9 cover the schema and its contract tests. Its own Agent Priority explicitly excludes the business logic a tool merely wraps, which is why python-backend-engineer stays on the row for push_gate.py's own logic; integration-testing-engineer stays for the contract-equivalence AC (test_push_gate.py's assertions passing against the new path).

routes.title: ADR-017: build the assert_push_gate_reachable() CI assertion
routes.justification: assert_push_gate_reachable() is an architecture fitness function run in CI that asserts on the replacement's reachability and must not assert on the old hook's presence. unit-testing-specialist supports on the mandatory companion negative test proving the assertion can fail.

routes.title: PRD FR-7 / SRS FR-17: six explicit slash-command entry points
routes.justification: GAP-1 CLOSED for this row 2026-08-02. Six slash commands are only reachable if they are discovered: claude-code-plugin-packaging-core section 1 fixes commands/ at the plugin ROOT and names nesting it under .claude-plugin/ as the single most common authoring mistake, one that installs cleanly and silently exposes zero capabilities. Section 4 requires each command's script to resolve its own files through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. Those two facts were the missing half; the agent carries them as Operating Rules 1 and 4. automation-engineer retained for the Python behind the commands, graph-orchestration-runtime-engineer retained because the sixth command drives the full pipeline Steps 0-8.

routes.title: PRD FR-4 / SRS FR-13: delete the PreToolUse and PostToolUse hook registrations
routes.justification: The action is a settings.json registration removal; the risk is what goes dark. impact-analysis-agent supports on confirming the measured 135-of-2218-node blast radius and zero surviving cross-boundary edges. Do not start until all five blockers have landed.

routes.title: PRD FR-5 / SRS FR-15: take UserPromptSubmit off the every-prompt hot path
routes.justification: Removing UserPromptSubmit from the every-prompt path is the same registration-surface edit as V2-027, gated on V2-026 existing. No second capability needed.

routes.title: PRD FR-4a / SRS FR-14: record the blast-radius measurement and its three named consequences
routes.justification: The deliverable is ADR-006 body content cross-referencing three named consequences, which is ADR authorship. impact-analysis-agent supports on the blast-radius measurement being recorded.

routes.title: PRD FR-22 / SRS FR-34: add the SRS Change Log row dated to the hook-deletion PR
routes.justification: An append-only SRS Change Log row referencing a superseding FR by number is requirements-document lifecycle work. The row must be dated to the hook-deletion PR, not back-dated.

routes.title: PRD NFR-3 / SRS NFR-9: name the CheckpointManager contract and fix 3 durability defects
routes.justification: Naming the CheckpointManager contract, refusing a best-effort checkpoint write, and making the progress surface a projection rather than a second writer is checkpointing-persistence architecture on a LangGraph runtime. distributed-consensus-engineer supports on defect 3, replay idempotency for side-effecting steps under a session-id-plus-step-number key.

routes.title: PRD FR-8 / SRS FR-18: keep Stop and Notification as user-level registrations, byte-identical across install/uninstall
routes.justification: GAP-1 CLOSED for this row 2026-08-02. The stated reason for MEDIUM was that no library agent owned plugin-lifecycle testing. The lifecycle half now has an owner: claude-code-plugin-packaging-core section 2's four-scope table places Stop and Notification in user scope (~/.claude/settings.json) as a layer the plugin's own install/uninstall must not write to, and M4 derives why a merged key cannot be cleanly subtracted -- which is precisely what 'byte-identical across install/uninstall' asserts. The agent carries it as Core Responsibility 6 and Operating Rule 8. integration-testing-engineer stays primary because the deliverable is a standing test.

routes.title: PRD FR-8a / SRS FR-19: instrument the Stop hook over 20 invocations and decide each capability
routes.justification: Instrumenting 20 consecutive REAL Stop-hook invocations for subprocess count, wall-clock duration and which .exists() guards fired is runtime trace capture over an agent harness, with a regression gate at most-2 spawns. A static re-derivation does not satisfy it. performance-testing-engineer supports on the per-invocation timing methodology.

routes.title: PRD FR-21 / SRS FR-33: fix or formally retire the 7 dead Stop-hook script references
routes.justification: Seven references in hooks/stop_notifier/ that point at files absent from disk are dangling references, which is dead-code-detection territory. business-analyst-agent supports because the retirement path requires each lost capability to appear with a disposition in the FR-12 / NFR-10 ledger.

routes.title: PRD NFR-2 / SRS NFR-8: replace fixed pipeline timeouts with 5 non-temporal control mechanisms
routes.justification: The best single match in the set: four of the five required ADR-016 mechanisms map directly onto this agent's mandatory skills (attempt-count bound and convergence signal to stop-condition-budget-control-core; circuit breaker with non-fixed reopen-wait and full-jitter retry to retry-backoff-circuit-breaker-core). loop-safety-engineer supports on the no-progress/termination proof. Lease renewal is the one mechanism neither agent owns by name.

routes.title: D7: migration guide, CHANGELOG, and VERSION bump to 2.0.0
routes.justification: Supporting agent CORRECTED 2026-08-02, confidence unchanged at HIGH. postmortem-facilitator-agent was carrying the migration-guide half on the strength of the library's only runbook skill, and was the wrong trigger for the same reason it was wrong on V2-021. technical-writer-agent replaces it: procedural-documentation-core section 1 gives the migration-guide anatomy explicitly as a distinct four-part form (pre-migration checklist / phased steps / post-migration verification with a bake-time window / rollback-abort plan), and section 4 supplies the point-of-no-return discipline the 8-step runbook's 'Required before steps 3 and 5' safety property depends on. release-engineering-specialist keeps VERSION, CHANGELOG and the SemVer bump.

routes.title: Resolve the VERSION vs CLAUDE.md version contradiction
routes.justification: VERSION is the single source of truth under rules/11 and CLAUDE.md:4 is the stale side. Version-source-of-truth reconciliation is release-versioning-management-core. Closes as absorbed if V2-036 lands first and fixes both.
